sections.heading: style-124 · Translucent Tissue-Paper Collage — 3 s silent preview

children.value:
Subject: an idea becomes a connected system. 1280x720, 30 fps, 3 s, silent.
Pipeline: HyperFrames (index.html, one paused GSAP timeline at

rows.Beat: Back layers lay down: top and bottom light bands, a vertical shaft and two slanted light shafts slide and rotate into place; kelp fronds rise with back.out.
rows.Focal point: Overlapping translucent bands compound into lighter areas

rows.Beat: The idea seed appears as three stacked blobs (outer, mid, core) that scale up and settle; where they overlap they build a glowing core.
Tissue fish and bubbles lay down in the front layer; headings fade and rise (0.6, 0.85, 1.15 s).
The tail strip lays down along its length from the seed to the network.
Eight network nodes lay down in sequence, then eight connecting strips lay down node to node.
Drift parallax eases from 0 to 1: back layers move against mid layers, kelp sways, fish swim right and bubbles rise. All motion settles by 2.7 s.
Hold on the settled, legible composition.

children.value:
Text (standalone headings, independent timing): "An idea becomes" / "a connected system" / "LAYERS OF LIGHT, DRIFTING TOGETHER".
No arrows, and no labels inside containers.
Determinism: mulberry32 and hash noise with stored seeds. Geometry and textures are built once at load, and each frame is redrawn from scratch from the timeline state on seek, totalTime and hf-seek.
